known_issues: TOOLING: the implicit `reference` control cannot be built for this task. tools/study/src/rhenium_study/controls.py:88-102 relocates /app and /solution only inside solution/solve.sh, but this task's solve.sh delegates to solution/solve.py, which hard-codes ROOT = /app/linge-hud (solve.py:5). `rhenium-study e0 baseline` aborted here (no reference.execution.json, and no baseline at all for the following task). All controls of this task are therefore `base=starter` with complete patches; reference-equivalent.patch reproduces the oracle tree byte-for-byte and was executed once as evidence (see NOTES.md).

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-release-regressions-hard-v3/tests/suite.nut:870-878 (qualified-entityflame-tick-uses-real-health-loss): the mock victim keeps health 70 and no pre-damage callback is driven, so the only way to obtain 12 is to multiply the reported 4 by 3 for weapon=entityflame/type=268435464. An implementation that derives the real loss from observed health (pre-damage snapshot vs. post-hit health), which the public wording "while the target actually lost 12 health" equally supports, reports 4 and fails. Over-constraining towards the reference strategy.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-release-regressions-hard-v3/tests/suite.nut:695-714 and :749-771: the terminal Survivor fixtures encode one specific engine convention (post-hit health is negative by temporary+overflow while GetHealthBuffer() still returns the pre-hit buffer; pre-hit health is still readable during player_incapacitated_start). Implementations are only accepted if their arithmetic matches that convention or they use the VSLib OnTakeDamage pre-damage chain; this is documented in the maintainer NOTES.md as the supported boundary.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-release-regressions-hard-v3/tests/suite.nut:33-50 and verify.py:328-395: the whole suite is one server boot. If the VM or server crashes mid-run (historically during case 28 for submissions whose Hint.nut merges the DOMINATE/REVIVE lifecycle, see harbor NOTES.md), no unique FINAL marker exists, verify.py raises before printing any case, and all 42 cases are unobserved (U) rather than failed.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-release-regressions-hard-v3/tests/suite.nut:52-120: all players are Squirrel mock objects, not engine entities; HUD/RewardHP cases therefore check event-handler arithmetic inside the real VM, not engine damage. Only the Hint cases touch real entities (env_instructor_hint through DoEntFire).

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-linge-release-regressions-hard-v3/tests/suite.nut:585, 713, 746, 770: terminal labels are matched by Chinese substrings ("杀死", "倒") in any captured message; the public text never fixes the wording, so a submission that rephrases the terminal messages fails these cases.

The Hint defect is `DOMINATE = 0` in enum HINTMODE: Squirrel does not advance its implicit counter after an explicit value, so REVIVE silently also becomes 0. The public smoke check cannot reveal this.
